searchText: Spec Sync #56 - <@689161464829050960> got a few more modexp tests passing. Still plugging away at it. - <@886437394675548190> working on the next hard fork docs - <@243183686562873344> better extraction of historical states (faster!) <@243183686562873344> did you handle precompiles in access lists? i.e. the note in `precompsEIP2929Filler.yml` Yes, we pass those tests. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/554/commits/a6a9c5acd53900c9b61a5255f55b8a811c526576#diff-4b2e1a485bc28fa10430183dfc23fb0975a24c5ff1361b384bcea680be32172fR97 <- Implementation is here Perfect. Just wanted to make sure ```python def subtract_gas(gas_left: U256, amount: Union[U256, Uint]) -> U256: if gas_left < amount: raise OutOfGasError return gas_left - U256(amount) ``` How would we feel about this for `subtract_gas`? It would treat all `amount > U256.MAX_VALUE` as `OutOfGasError` instead of the parent frame throwing a `ValueError`.
